verses.sanskrit:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच।
              तस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायामुदिते सूर्यमण्डले। कृतपौर्वाह्णिकाः सर्वे समेयुस्ते तपोधनाः॥१॥
verses.english: Markandeya said : The night having come to a close, when the sun's disc had appeared (on the horizon), all th 'se ascetius, whose only wealth devotion, having performed their mations, congregated (at the asylum of Dyumatsena).

verses.sanskrit: तदेव सर्वं सावित्र्या महाभाग्यं महर्षयः। द्युमत्सेनाय नातृप्यन् कथयन्तः पुनः पुनः॥२॥
verses.english: was Those great sages were never satisfied in relating again and again of the high fortune of Savitri, to Dyumatsena.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रकृतयः सर्वाः शाल्वेभ्योऽभ्यागता नृप। आचख्युर्निहतं चैव स्वेनामात्येन तं द्विषम्॥३॥
verses.english: Then, O king, it so chanced that all the subjects came from Shalva and informed Dyumatsena of the death of his enemy at the hands of his own minister.

verses.sanskrit: तं मन्त्रिणा हतं श्रुत्वा ससहायं सबान्धवम्। न्यवेदयन् यथावृत्तं विद्रुतं च द्विषद्बलम्॥४॥
verses.english: And they related to him all that had taken place saying "hearing the death of the usurper together with his friends and allies at the hands of his own minister and of the dispersion of his troops, all the subjects have in one voice declared for you, their legitimate king and they have also said whether you are blind or not you shall be (their) king.

verses.sanskrit: ऐकमत्यं च सर्वस्य जनस्याथ नृपं प्रति। सचक्षुर्वाऽप्यचक्षुर्वा स नो राजा भवत्विति॥५॥
अनेन निश्चयेनेह वयं प्रस्थापिता नृप। प्राप्तानीमानि यानानि चतुरङ्गं च ते बलम्॥६॥
verses.english: O king, we have been dispatched to you on the strength of this determination (on the part of your subjects to install you king). These cars and these four kinds of troops have arrived for you.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयाहि राजन् भद्रं ते घुष्टस्ते नगरे जयः। अध्यास्व चिररात्राय पितृपैतामहं पदम्॥७॥
verses.english: (Therefore), O monarch, do set out. May you prosper. Your restoration has been proclaimed in the city. May you for ever occupy the portion filled by your sire and grandsire."

verses.sanskrit: चक्षुष्मन्तं च तं दृष्टा राजानं वपुषाऽन्वितम्। मूर्ध्ना निपतिताः सर्वे विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनाः॥८॥
verses.english: And seeing the king restored to sight and healthy, they with their eyes expanded in wonder, bowed down their heads to him.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽभिवाद्य तान् वृद्धान् द्विजानाश्रमवासिनः। तैश्चाभिपूजितः सर्वैः प्रययौ नगरं प्रति॥९॥
verses.english: Then the king having greeted all the aged Brahmanas inhabiting the hermitage and in his turn being greeted by them, set out for his capital.

verses.sanskrit: शैब्या च सह सावित्र्या स्वास्तीर्णेन सुवर्चसा। नरयुक्तेन यानेन प्रययौ सेनया वृता॥१०॥
verses.english: And Shaivya together with Savitri surrounded by troops, went in a palanquin, adorned with splendid sheets and carried by men.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽभिषिषिचुः प्रीत्या द्युमत्सेनं पुरोहिताः। पुत्रं चास्य महात्मानं यौवराज्येऽभ्यषेचयन्॥११॥
verses.english: Then the priests joyfully installed Dyumatsena as king and his high-souled son as prince regent.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालेन महता सावित्र्याः कीर्तिवर्धनम्। तद्वै पुत्रशतं जज्ञे शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम्॥१२॥
verses.english: After a long time Savitri was deliver of a hundred heroic and illustrious sons who never retreated from battle.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातॄणां सोदराणां च तथैवास्याभवच्छतम्। मद्राधिपस्याश्वपतेर्मालव्यां सुमहद्बलम्॥१३॥
verses.english: She had also one hundred highly powerful uterine brothers begotten by Ashvapati, the king of Madra, on Malavi.

verses.sanskrit: एवमात्मा पिता माता श्वश्रूः श्वशुर एव च। भर्तुः कुलं च सावित्र्या सर्वं कृच्छ्रात् समुद्धृतम्॥१४॥
verses.english: Thus Savitri rescued from misfortune, her own self, her father, mother-in law, father-inlaw and her husband's line.

verses.sanskrit: तथैवैषा हि कल्याणी द्रौपदी शीलसम्मता। तारयिष्यति वः सर्वान् सावित्रीव कुलाङ्गना॥१५॥
verses.english: Similarly, the auspicious Draupadi of excellent character, will deliver you all from your misfortune as the virtuous Savitri did.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवं स पाण्डवस्तेन अनुनीतो महात्मना। विशोको विज्वरो राजन् काम्यके न्यवसत् तदा॥१६॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : Thus, O monarch, instructed by that highsouled one ((Markandeya), the Pandava (Yudhishthira) devoid of grief and affliction continued to dwell in Kamyaka.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चेदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या सावित्र्याख्यानमुत्तमम्। स सुखी सर्वसिद्धार्थो न दुःखं प्राप्नुयान्नरः॥१७॥
verses.english: The man who listens with a devout spirit, to the excellent history of Savitri ever meets with happiness and success and never experiences sorrow.
